status_lines: INDEPENDENT EVALUATION NOT AUTHORIZED OR CONDUCTED

candidate_under_evaluation.identity_rule: Identified by its Phase 8 package hash; any change before Gate D invalidates the freeze.

questions.question: When the candidate marks a quotation as present, is the quoted text found in the record at the recorded offsets?
Does the candidate route to human review the conditions that independent labelers judge should not receive a supported status?
Does the candidate report the chronology conflicts that independent labelers identify, and only those?
Does the candidate refuse records in excluded domains, and avoid refusing records outside them?
Do Cognitive Controls prompts stay neutral (no direction towards an outcome) as judged by independent labelers?
Where the candidate reports text presence, do labelers find that the text semantically supports the condition, and does the candidate avoid presenting presence as support?

roles.duties: Authorizes each gate; does not label, adjudicate or operate.
Holds and releases authorized material; keeps sealed labels outside the repository.
Labels material blind to candidate output; independent of the developers and of each other.
Resolves disputed labels under the written rule; does not label the same item.
Runs the frozen candidate in the recorded environment; never sees labels before Gate E.
Reviews material authorization, privacy and disclosure before Gate A and at Gate F.

separation_rules: No person holds both a developer or technical_operator role and a labeler or adjudicator role.
Labelers do not see candidate output before labeling.

materials.use: Development and regression only. Never used to report evaluation results.
Labeler training and rule calibration; results not reported as performance.
Blind execution only, after protocol freeze.
Prohibited unless separately authorized in writing under Gate A with counsel review.

blinding_and_contamination: Developers have no access to sealed evaluation labels.
Sealed evaluation material is never copied into the repository.
No prompt, rule pack, model or code change after the protocol freeze (Gate B); any such change voids the freeze and requires a new freeze.
Ambiguous or disputed labels go to the adjudicator under a written rule recorded before labeling; adjudication outcomes are recorded with reasons.
The candidate package hash, environment and clock are recorded at freeze and at execution; any difference stops the evaluation.

measures.name: quote-verification precision
measures.definition: Of quotations the candidate marks as verified, the share that labelers confirm as present at the recorded offsets.

measures.name: quote-verification recall
measures.definition: Of quotations labelers identify as present and relevant, the share the candidate marks as verified.

measures.name: routing agreement
measures.definition: Share of conditions where the candidate route (supported, review_required, not_assessed, refusal) matches the adjudicated label.

measures.name: false-refusal rate
measures.definition: Share of in-scope records the candidate refuses.

measures.name: missed-conflict rate
measures.definition: Share of labeled chronology or control conflicts the candidate does not report.

measures.name: inter-rater agreement
measures.definition: Chance-corrected agreement between independent labelers before adjudication; statistic named at freeze.

measures.name: adjudication rate
measures.definition: Share of labeled items that required adjudication.

measures.name: abstention or review-required rate
measures.definition: Share of conditions the candidate routes to review_required or not_assessed.

stop_conditions: unexplained candidate drift (package hash differs from the freeze)
any attempt to claim performance before the evaluation is completed

gates.name: material authorization
gates.requires: Owner and counsel or privacy reviewer authorize material classes, sources and retention in writing.

gates.name: protocol freeze
gates.requires: Candidate package hash, rule packs, prompts, environment, measures and adjudication rule frozen and sealed.

gates.name: independent labeling
gates.requires: Labelers confirmed independent; labels completed blind and sealed by the data custodian.

gates.name: blind execution
gates.requires: Technical operator runs the frozen candidate; package hash and environment match the freeze.

gates.name: adjudication
gates.requires: Disputes resolved under the written rule; measures calculated only now.

gates.name: owner and counsel review
gates.requires: Owner and counsel review results and limits before any statement is made.
